summary: Round-5 responsive layout & overflow audit of /construction.html (frontend only, static page, no backend). DOM-geometry probes (no file edits) across 11 viewports: 1920x1080, 1680x1050, 1536x864, 1440x900, 1366x768, 1280x800, 1024x768, 834x1194, 430x932, 390x844, 375x812. Verified: zero horizontal overflow at all 11 viewports, zero console/page errors, heading integrity (eyebrow + H1/H2 + subtitle simultaneously clear of the fixed header and inside the viewport) reachable for all 14 sections at 1920/1366/390, section 06 vertical-steps state machine (exactly one .cx-insp-col.is-on, monotone forward 0-5 and reverse 5-0, stage label always index-matched, all bullets rendered, sequence SVG unclipped), pinned sections 01/03/04/05/07 state sync forward+reverse at 1440 and 390, section 03 seismic drawing single-annotation (0 overlapping <text> pairs), 7 MEP tabs index-aligned, endnote readability. 7 layout/behaviour defects found (1 critical, 5 high, 1 medium) plus 4 minor.

ui_bugs.issue: Refresh while scrolled mid-section resets the active card to C.01 and the stage label to index 0 instead of the index matching the scroll position, and it does NOT self-correct on a subsequent 4px scroll. Reproduced at 1440x900 (scrollY=28274, secTop=27040, secH=2468 -> 50% into the section, expected ~C.03/C.04, got C.01) and at 390x844 (before reload C.03, after reload C.01). Root cause: verticalSteps() (js/construction.js ~line 489) force-sets is-on on index 0 at creation and then relies only on ScrollTrigger onUpdate, which does not fire when the page loads already positioned inside the section.

390x844: active principle A.04 'Transverse reinforcement & confinement' block measures 506px but .cx-copywin is only 391px tall and has overflow:hidden -> 125px clipped at the bottom. Reproduced at scrollY 22838 / 23125 / 23412. The approved TBDY 2018 hook/cross-tie copy is unreadable (confirmed by screenshot: text stops mid-sentence at '...prescribed by TBDY').

390x844: for the last state (A.06 Concrete cover) the tracked column is shifted so the active block's top sits 283-290px ABOVE .cx-copywin top (block 316px, window 391px) for scrollY 25134-25995 -> nearly the whole A.06 card is clipped at the top while the section is still pinned. Also 46px/165px at 24560/24847.

390x844: for the final ~25% of the pin (scrollY >= 5863) the last card (06 Structural core, block 318px) is shifted 196px above .cx-copywin top (window 458px) -> the card index, title and first paragraph are clipped (screenshot shows only a cut partial line 'architectural function.' above the closing paragraph). Also 12px at 5357 and 123px at 5610.

390x844: active node 05's index+title row is 34px above .cx-copywin top for scrollY 33658-34367 -> the node number and title are hidden and the card starts mid-copy ('Roof waterproofing is developed as a continuous system...'), confirmed by screenshot.

375x812: SVG captions overlap the closing H1. 'CONCEPTUAL SYNTHESIS' overlaps .cx-h1 by 142x7px and 'NO PERFORMANCE VALUES IMPLIED' overlaps it by 209x13px. At 390x844 the same pile-up reproduces intermittently (scroll-position dependent): measured 157x13px overlap between the SVG text 'CONCEPTUAL SYNTHESIS' and the '12 / Result' .cx-idx eyebrow, confirmed by screenshot. No overlap at 430x932, 834x1194, 1440x900 or 1920x1080, so the <=900px two-row .cx-final-stage grid still leaves the diagram row too short at <=390px.

Sticky offset is hard-coded to top:110px while the fixed .site-header bottom edge varies (70px with .bar-hidden, 110px normally, measured 150px with the promo bar visible). At 1440x900, scrollY=28891-ish (55% into section 06) the bar occupied 110-142px while header bottom was 150px -> the entire 32px stage row (including the active 'ENCLOSURE' label) was fully occluded by the header.

1440x900: at state-transition offsets the active block extends 5-10px below .cx-copywin (overflow:hidden) - measured clipBot 9px @22756, 5px @23062, 9px @23674, 9px @24592, 8px @24898, 10px @25204. Sub-line clipping only.

390x844: computed position is 'static' throughout the section, so the stage row does not stick under the header while the six controls are read (acceptance item asked for a sticky stage row). It scrolls away after C.01.

integration_issues.issue: Stopped at 50% of sections 05/06/07 then resized: after ScrollTrigger refresh the section is pushed completely out of the viewport (stillInView=false) and the active index jumps to the last state (05: 3->5, 06: 4->5, 07: 3->4). No stale or duplicated active state and no horizontal overflow (scrollWidth 1024 === innerWidth 1024), but the reading position is lost because scrollY is preserved in px while section heights change. Report as behaviour note, not a hard failure.

issues: SVG annotation <text> is larger than the section body copy: 390x844 max svg font-size 15px vs body .cx-p 10px (08/09/10) and 15px vs 13.5px (12); 1440x900 envelope 10.05px vs 10px, acoustics 10.7px vs 10px. Acceptance item 4 requires annotation text never larger than body copy - fitDwgType() cap is not effective at <=390px.

action_items: CRITICAL: section 06 - after verticalSteps() is created (and on every ScrollTrigger.refresh), invoke the index callback once with the ScrollTrigger's current progress so a refresh/reload mid-section resolves to the correct C.0x card and stage label instead of C.01.

390x844 section 05: A.04 block (506px) does not fit .cx-copywin (391px) - 125px of approved TBDY copy is clipped. Increase the mobile reading-window height (or reduce the mobile .cx-cage-viz share) so the tallest state fits.

390x844 sections 01/05/07: the last-state / tracked shift pushes the active card 34-290px above .cx-copywin top, clipping the card index, title and copy. Clamp the copyTracker shift so the active block's top never goes above the window top.

375x812 (and intermittently 390x844) section 12: .cx-final diagram captions ('CONCEPTUAL SYNTHESIS', 'NO PERFORMANCE VALUES IMPLIED') overlap the .cx-idx eyebrow / .cx-h1 by up to 209x13px. Give the diagram row an explicit min-height (or move the captions inside the diagram row) below 400px width.

Section 06 .cx-insp-bar: replace the hard-coded sticky top:110px with a value derived from the live header height/offset (CSS var updated by script.js) so the stage row is never hidden behind the header; also make it sticky on mobile.
Cap SVG <text> font-size to <= body copy size at <=430px (currently 15px vs 10-13.5px body).
critical_code_review_comments: js/construction.js verticalSteps(): `items.forEach((it,i)=>it.classList.toggle('is-on', i===0))` runs after ScrollTrigger.create but the trigger's onUpdate is not invoked on initial load, so any load/refresh already inside the section leaves a wrong active index permanently (no scroll event corrects it because the ScrollTrigger's cached progress already matches). Drive the initial state from st.progress.

.cx-copywin uses overflow:hidden with a mask; any tracker shift or block taller than the window silently deletes approved copy. Add a runtime assertion/clamp: activeBlock.top >= win.top && activeBlock.bottom <= win.bottom.

.cx-insp-bar sticky top is hard-coded (110px) and duplicates a value owned by .site-header in styles.css (top:40px + --header-h, plus .bar-hidden state). Expose the header offset as a CSS custom property instead.

success_rate.frontend: Acceptance criteria: 1) heading integrity PASS (all 14 sections, 1920/1366/390); 2) no clipped text FAIL (4 sections clipped at 390x844); 3) zero horizontal overflow PASS (11/11 viewports); 4) pinned-section height FAIL (section 05 at 390x844); 5) mobile/tablet readability FAIL at 390/375; 6) deterministic active state PASS on slow/fast/reverse scroll and resize, FAIL on refresh mid-section 06. ~65%

context_for_next_testing_agent: Probes used (all DOM geometry, ~0.5s settle after each scroll): (a) overflow: documentElement.scrollWidth vs window.innerWidth at 11 viewports - PASS everywhere; the off-canvas .side-menu sits at negative x by design and is not overflow. (b) heading integrity must be tested by sampling scroll offsets from secTop-260 to secTop+12%h and asserting 'exists an offset where .cx-idx + h1/h2 + .cx-lbl are ALL below #siteHeader bottom and inside the viewport'. Do NOT use scrollIntoView({block:'start'}) - it parks the section top at y=0 which puts every heading behind the 70-110px fixed header and produces false positives. (c) clipping must be measured against .cx-copywin (overflow:hidden): clipTop = win.top - block.top, clipBot = block.bottom - win.bottom, using the item + its .cx-el-d/.cx-prin-d/.cx-wp-node-d detail. (d) .cx-endnote sits OUTSIDE .cx-copywin, so test it against the viewport, not the window. Confirmed PASS areas that do not need re-testing unless code changes: section 03 seismic label pile-up (0 overlapping <text> pairs), MEP 7 tabs (note a `[data-testid^="cx-mep-tab"]` selector also matches the 'cx-mep-tabs' wrapper -> use `.cx-mep-tab`), section 06 state machine forward/reverse/bullets/SVG, reload mid-section 05 (index preserved), zero console/page errors.
rca_of_the_issue: Two independent root causes. (1) Section 06 stale state: verticalSteps() seeds is-on on index 0 and depends exclusively on ScrollTrigger onUpdate; on a load that starts inside the section the trigger's progress is already correct so onUpdate never fires, leaving C.01 active permanently (a 4px nudge does not recover it). (2) Mobile clipping: at 390x844 the .cx-copywin reading window is 391-458px while the client's replaced copy produces blocks up to 506px, and the copyTracker last-state shift (js/construction.js ~365-380) now runs to the end of the column to expose .cx-endnote, which pushes the final card 196-290px above the window top. Because .cx-copywin is overflow:hidden with a mask, the excess copy is silently deleted rather than overflowing visibly.
